login.title: Sign in
login.redirectNote: You will be redirected to your organisation's identity provider to sign in.

idp_unreachable.title: Your identity provider could not be reached
idp_unreachable.description: The sign-in service did not respond, and nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

invalid_callback.title: Sign-in could not be completed
invalid_callback.description: The response from the identity provider was missing, had expired or did not match the request that started it. Start again.

not_configured.title: Sign-in is not available
not_configured.description: This deployment has no identity provider configured yet, so there is nothing to do from this page.

session_expired.title: Your session has ended
session_expired.description: Sign in again to continue where you left off.

signed_out.title: You have signed out
signed_out.description: The session in this browser has been closed.

panel.statement: Where your books and an authority's copy disagree, shown with the rule it was checked under.
panel.status: The console runs on synthetic data only.

advice.title: Not tax advice
advice.description: A finding says two sources disagree under a cited rule. It never says what you owe or whether something is lawful.

citation.title: Every finding cites a rule
citation.description: Each finding names the rule it was evaluated under, so the reasoning can be checked.

credentials.title: The browser never holds your credentials
credentials.description: Sign-in happens at your identity provider. Your session is an encrypted, HTTP-only cookie, and the access token inside it can only be opened on the server.
